LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.0.label: Chronoblade Rhythm
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.0.descr: Retains original rage stacking, duration and melee/ranged cooldown attributes. Later nodes count actual ordinary hits; abilities and secondary damage do not charge them. They do not raise the rage cap. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.1.label: Three-beat Cut
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.1.descr: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, no more than 1.5 seconds apart, deal 50 bonus damage, once per 6 seconds. Changing targets or exceeding the interval restarts the count. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.2.label: Lingering Cut
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.2.descr: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, no more than 3 seconds apart, leave a cut at the third impact cell. After 1 second, it deals 50 damage to up to two enemies within 2 cells and clear sight of that cell. It stays in place, with one pending cut maximum and an 8-second cooldown. Changing targets restarts the count. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.3.label: Measured Respite
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.3.descr: After Three-beat Cut deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 6 seconds. Permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.4.label: Guarded Beat
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.4.descr: After Three-beat Cut deals actual bonus damage, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.5.label: Delayed Respite
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.5.descr: After Lingering Cut deals actual damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Hitting several enemies with one cut still heals only once; an empty or fully prevented pulse grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.6.label: Offbeat Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Chronoblade.nodes.6.descr: After Lingering Cut deals actual damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. One trigger per cut maximum; never substitutes you when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.
